g.text: or: equating two unequal things is always equating them with respect to something (the unit)
"Four plums are the same as 1 phone" - that's nonsense
But "four plums weigh the same as one phone"
So, equating with respect to weight really is
"Four hundred plums are the same as 1 phone" - still nonsense
But "four hundred plums contain the same sized blob of
gelatinous abstract labor as one phone does" equates with
So, equating through exchange is implicitly about something like:
things isn't possible until they have
been reduced to the same unit"
